subject: Nathan: Petri max_turns 30 -> 10
body: Nathan's decision, typed in the Summarizer session: set petri.max_turns to 10 in configs/models.json (currently 30). Please fold it into the same push as the no-Anthropic lineup change. If results/prereg/E3b.json or scripts/c2_baseline.sh / c2_e3b.py pin a turn count, make them match (10) so the pilot and every later E3b run use the same limit. This was chosen for cost: the Qwen3-235B auditor's GPU time scales with turns. Reply to nathan-c with the commit hash.
